purpose: Starter set of approximate typical weights for common RAN/ADF equipment and field stores, used as a lookup while completing the load exposure builder. Preparation support only. Weights are approximate and admin-editable; they are not an authoritative source and must not be treated as a measurement of any individual's service.
sourceLabel: Virtual Advocate PI starter reference set (approximate, admin-editable)
